1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) in an organisation where the Dashboard feature is on, on the build under test (sv8311.qa.shopview.com); a single workplace is selected.
  2. A workplace with data across several months.

changes.label: Expected Result
changes.old_value:
Expected results

  • The four KPI tiles open on This Month; the Sales by Customer tile opens on Last 12 Months.
  • A tile's date range is not carried between visits — every visit opens each tile on its default.
  • If the selected range has not finished, the tile's headline and sparkline both describe the same partial window.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9579 (S7 — Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S7; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R7: “The four KPI tiles open on This Month. The Sales by Customer tile opens on Last 12 Months.”
  • S7-R8: “A tile's date range is not carried between visits. Every visit opens each tile on its default from S7-R7, which is why date ranges are absent from the remembered list in S6-R16. This is a deliberate change from the earlier dashboard, which remembered them.”
  • S7-E1: “If the selected range has not finished, the tile's headline and sparkline both describe the same partial window.”

changes.new_value:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Open the dashboard fresh and confirm the four KPI tiles default to This Month and the Sales by Customer tile to Last 12 Months.
2. Change some ranges, leave and revisit, and confirm each tile opens on its default again (ranges are not remembered).
3. On a range that has not finished, confirm the headline and sparkline both describe the same partial window.
changes.new_value:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
  3. Change the Revenue pill to Last Year (click Apply if the calendar stays open).
  4. Change the Sales by Customer pill to This Week.
  5. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  6. Click Dashboard in the top bar again.
  7. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
  8. Sign out, sign back in and click Dashboard.
  9. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
